name: EVENTS-001-F05 Edit events with explicit series scope

background.text: the phone time zone is UTC
the phone language is English United States

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S20 Edit a one-time event without creating a duplicate

steps.text: Dentist starts at 09:30 on 2027-02-06 with description Checkup
the owner edits Dentist to Consultation at 11:00 on 2027-02-07 with description Followup and saves
Consultation is represented at 11:00 on 2027-02-07
its details show description Followup
the computed interval is 2027-02-07 11:00 to 2027-02-07 12:00 in UTC
no event named Dentist exists
exactly 1 event exists from 2027-02-06 through 2027-02-07

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S21 Change between all-day and timed modes

steps.text: Switch is <original_mode> on 2027-02-06
the owner changes Switch to <target_mode> and saves, choosing 09:00 if timed
Switch details show <target_mode> on 2027-02-06
exactly 1 event named Switch exists
no duration, event end-time or event end-date adjustment is offered

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S22 Move and customize only one recurring occurrence

steps.text: Course repeats daily at 09:00 from 2027-06-01 for 5 occurrences with description Base
the owner edits only the occurrence originally on 2027-06-03 to Custom at 11:00 on 2027-06-04 with description Local and saves
no Course occurrence starts on 2027-06-03
Custom starts at 11:00 on 2027-06-04 with description Local
no occurrence of the original series starts on 2027-06-06

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S23 Series text edits preserve individual fields and cancellations

steps.text: the Course exception fixture is prepared
the owner changes the series title to Renamed and description to Shared with scope <scope> from 2027-06-03 and saves
the 2027-06-01 occurrence has title <first_title> and description <first_description> at 09:00
the 2027-06-02 occurrence keeps title Custom and description Local at 09:00
the 2027-06-03 occurrence inherits title Renamed and description Shared but stays at 11:00
the 2027-06-04 occurrence remains deleted
the 2027-06-05 occurrence has title Renamed and description Shared at 09:00
no occurrence of the original series starts on 2027-06-06

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S24 Confirm before resetting temporal exceptions

steps.text: the Course exception fixture is prepared
the owner changes the series time to 10:00 with scope <scope> from 2027-06-03 and attempts to save
a warning identifies that affected individual modifications will reset and deleted occurrences may return
the owner confirms the reset
the 2027-06-01 occurrence starts at <first_time>
the 2027-06-02 occurrence has title <second_title> at <second_time>
no affected occurrence remains at 11:00
no occurrence of the original series starts on 2027-06-06

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S25 Cancelling a reset warning changes no saved event

steps.text: the Course exception fixture is prepared
the owner changes the series time to 10:00 with scope <scope> from 2027-06-03 and attempts to save
the owner cancels the reset warning and abandons the editor
the Course exception fixture remains unchanged

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S26 Recurrence edits keep the remaining occurrence budget unless changed

steps.text: Course repeats daily at 09:00 from 2027-06-01 for 5 occurrences with description Base
the owner changes the recurrence interval to 2 days with scope <scope> from 2027-06-03 without changing the ending and saves
Course starts at 09:00 on exactly <expected_dates>
no Course occurrence starts on <absent_date>

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S27 A new future count starts with the first affected occurrence

steps.text: Course repeats daily at 09:00 from 2027-06-01 for 5 occurrences with description Base
the owner sets the ending to after 2 occurrences with scope this and future from 2027-06-03 and saves
no Course occurrence starts on 2027-06-05

scenarios.name: EVENTS-001-S40 Other structural fields also require reset consent

steps.text: the Course exception fixture is prepared
the owner changes series field <field> to <value> with scope whole series from 2027-06-03 and attempts to save
a warning identifies that affected individual modifications will reset and deleted occurrences may return
the owner cancels the reset warning and abandons the editor
the Course exception fixture remains unchanged
